The Circosta Law Firm receives clients at its offices in Gioiosa Ionica, Reggio Calabria, Rome and Milan, and can be reached by phone, e-mail and PEC (certified e-mail) at the details listed on this page.

You may also request a call back from the Firm by completing the online form: enter your full name, e-mail address and, optionally, your phone number and company, and briefly describe your legal matter (for example civil litigation, an international contract or criminal defence). Fields marked with * are mandatory.
